PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
